Pusslet uses open data from these sources. Thank you!
Pusslet does not use any AI service. All interpretation is done with rules on the phone.
Nutrition values. Licence CC BY 4.0, source: Livsmedelsverket.

The family's information is stored on the phone and – once you sign in – with Google Firebase within the EU. Children only need a first name. Nothing is sold, no ads, no AI.
